notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Storm Cauldron triggers twice, returning both lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 for the other trigger.
Repeat from step 1.
